provenance.source: Fly capacity probe /project/fly-capacity-probe-20261106/probe.json (peak_org_machines=132, 60 Machines, this box) and the provider cap refusal of scripts/cloudbench-provider-capacity.py
provenance.recorded: The refusal text is the real output of `python3 scripts/cloudbench-provider-capacity.py check --benches 40` (exit 78) and `cap` (16) at the base commit; machines_per_org_limit=1000 is the value scripts/run-bench-fleet documents for the org.
provenance.synthesized: The 8-task -k 5 --concurrency 40 launch wrapper around the refusal; the Fly GraphQL JSON envelope.
provenance.prompt: Synthesized. No real user /benchmark invocation of this scenario type was found. Searched 2026-11-09 (user-role `dvb-onbox threads search --scope project`): "/benchmark" plus agent-payment, --local, -k, polar, smoke, browser, parallel-tool-calls, mass-agent, whm, reclaim, --check, stop and production variants; "stop the benchmark run", "kill the fleet run", "cancel the benchmark", "reclaim stopped machines", "reclaim-stopped", "stopped machines count against the limit", "benchmark is stuck stale", "is it stuck", "run locally"; and the local Claude sessions in /home/boxes/.claude/projects/-home-boxes-rose (no /benchmark command). Real user /benchmark invocations that exist: '/benchmark 20|70 random polar tasks, with a 5 min execution timeout' (thr_52266c65da8b45598e450991df9af4a0, thr_91319b251a6a4d38b09e95b2a903b9bc, thr_792e7cfc59ca470ea9b42c880b956441, thr_72c2ed21b54d47398c4b1a116914f847; 2026-10-19/20) and '/benchmark full' (bench-10). The runs this scenario cites were started by agents with scripts/run-bench, so its prompt stays synthesized.
